sources.note: Nothing; numeral morphology across six languages.

sources.citation: Kamanda Kola. 1990. Inventaire des langues et/ou dialectes oubanguiens. Annales Aequatoria 11: 165-187 (sec. 2.1.8 Ngbundu, c. pp.169-170).
sources.note: Nothing; location (south and east of Libenge) and bibliography only: Yembeline 1986 'Essai de grammaire ngbundu', memoire de licence ISP-Mbandaka, inedit; Yembeline 1990 (this volume).

sources.citation: Yembeline Kodangba. 1990. Le verbe en ngbundu. Annales Aequatoria 11: 203-226.
sources.note: Nothing. Verb morphophonology only; sec. 1.1 (p.205) says the verb consists of segmental morphemes and tonemes, the language has '5 tonemes' (transcription key: haut, moyen, bas, descendant, montant), sec. 1.3 (pp.207-208) gives grammatical functions of mid/high/falling tonemes; syllable types of radicals (CV, CVCV, VCV, CVCVCV). No word 'accent' or 'intensite' anywhere in the article.
